entities.summary: Cambodia is a sovereign nation in Southeast Asia, Asia. Its capital is Phnom Penh. Official languages include Khmer. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy (de facto dominant-party). Population: approximately 17.4 million. Area: 181,035 km². Comprehensive index for Cambodia covering prehistoric settlements, Funan maritime kingdom, Chenla, Khmer Empire (Angkor Wat, Jayavarman VII), post-Angkor decline, Vietnamese/Thai pressure, French protectorate 1863, Sihanouk era, secret US bombing, Khmer Rouge genocide (1975-1979), Vietnamese invasion, UNTAC, Hun Sen era, and modern reconstruction.
